stories.title: Define Explainability Response Schema
stories.description: Design and implement a structured response schema that includes measure_id, raw_value, normalized_score, weight, and contribution_to_final_score. Ensure compatibility with existing facade response composition patterns.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/application/facades/evaluate_care_facade.py (structured response composition exists and must be extended)

stories.title: Implement Measure Normalization and Contribution Logic
stories.description: Build core logic to transform raw measure values into normalized scores and compute weighted contribution to final score. Ensure deterministic calculations aligned with scoring model.
stories.evidence: ASSUMPTION: Scoring model requires normalization and weighting but no explicit implementation exists in current codebase; GAP: define normalization formulas and weights per measure

stories.title: Integrate Explainability into Evaluate Care Facade
stories.description: Extend evaluate_care_facade to include explainability breakdown in responses returned to the chat layer, ensuring compatibility with existing tool routing and response handling.

stories.title: Expose Explainability via API Contract
stories.description: Update FastAPI endpoint and tool response contract to include explainability payload, ensuring frontend/chat client can render measure-level breakdown.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/main.py (FastAPI host and response handling); tool_router.py (tool response contract)

stories.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Explainability Engine
stories.description: Create unit tests for normalization and contribution logic and integration tests validating full explainability payload returned from facade through API.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/tests/ (existing test suite structure supports unit and integration tests)
